title: Arielle Fleisher
intro:
Arielle Fleisher is running for election to the Oakland Unified Board of Education to represent District 2 in California. Fleisher is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Fleisher completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
